summary: Frontend-only verification of universal safe-area / dynamic bottom-padding fix across ALL navbar pages (A-Z). Confirmed no hardcoded pb-20/24/32/40 remain in /app/frontend/src/pages or /app/frontend/src/components. All Navbar pages (Discover, Likes, Alerts/Notifications, Chats/Matches, Profile, Settings, Privacy, Referral, ProfileEnhancement, ProfileViewers, AdminDashboard) use paddingBottom: calc(var(--nav-total, 86px) + 16px). ChatPage input area uses max(var(--safe-bottom, 8px), env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px), 8px). Tested on 390x844 and 412x915 (both required) plus 360x780. On every page, --nav-total (61px on 390, 63px on 412) exactly matches the measured navbar bounding-rect height; navbar sits pinned to viewport bottom (navRectBottom == innerHeight); all 5 nav tabs are visible and have >=48px touch targets (52-54px measured); no content is obscured by the navbar. The iteration_23 regression on the DiscoverPage action-button-to-navbar gap is FIXED: gaps are now 26px (small 360), 27px (medium 390) and 29px (large 412) — all >= 24px minimum.

critical_code_review_comments: safeArea.js now correctly computes navTotal = navInner + max(safeBottom, 8) + 1 (border), matching Navbar CSS max() floor. Good.
DiscoverPage.jsx still ~385 lines; consider extracting ProfileCard/ActionButtons/OutOfSwipesModal for maintainability (not blocking).
safeArea.js still creates/removes DOM probes on every measure() call. Cache env() support detection once at init to avoid resize thrash.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bug in this iteration. The prior iteration_23 regression (--nav-total under-reserved by 8px due to Navbar CSS floor) has been resolved in safeArea.js by: (1) enforcing `safeBottom = Math.max(safeBottom, 8)` universal floor and (2) computing `navTotal = navInner + safeBottom + 1` (adds 1px for border-top). Result: --nav-total == actual navRectHeight on both 390 and 412 viewports, and gap is 26-29px across all tested viewports.
